ledger: child | full upper body visible in blue hoodie | only hands and forearms visible | sudden cut to close-up
bowl of balls | contains red, green, and yellow balls | contains red, green, yellow, and orange balls | orange balls appear without source

findings.description: The video cuts abruptly from a medium shot showing the child's face and torso to a close-up of just the hands and bowl, causing the side table and small pot to disappear from view.
Orange balls appear in the bowl during the close-up sequence, but only red, green, and yellow balls were visible in the initial wide shot at 00:00.
